title: 第三章三灯齐亮震动龙家第四章龙家传承
content_zh:
看着秦风漫不经心的走来，龙云飞双拳紧握，咬牙喝道：“喂！！秦风！居然要让我们龙家这么多人等你一个？你还真是好大的牌面啊！！”
“哼，还以为你要当缩头乌龟了呢，想不到，居然真的敢来。”
“就不怕，你在龙家最后的一点脸面，也化为虚无吗？”
龙云沁也嘲讽道。
听到这对兄妹二人的话，秦风真想找个耳塞把耳朵堵着！！
不就是嫉妒自己比你们优秀，比你们更快突破到通天境么？至于这样？？
“晚辈秦风，拜见族长大人以及诸位前辈。”
秦风拱手行礼道。
听到秦风居然改口叫自己族长大人，龙战眉头一簇，似有不满，但最终还是点点头道：“准备好了？”
“本族长最后再提醒你一次，一旦进入神龙石像洞穴里，要么被横扫而出，要么就点了龙灯，若是后者，我们龙家或许还会继续栽培你。”
“若是前者......”
不等龙战把话说完，秦风便回应道：“我已经准备好了，随时都可以进去。”
“还望族长打开洞门！！”
“哼，装什么装？明明心里紧张的要死，却还故作镇定。”
“秦风，不得不说，你确实要比本少主能装！！”
龙云飞依旧嘲讽道。
龙战闻言，一个白眼丢了过去，然后声音洪亮道：“龙家养子，秦风！今日挑战龙灯，希望你能点亮三盏，得到我们龙家至宝，神龙真元。”
“另外，所有龙家人在此期间，必须安静。”
“若有谁胆敢聒噪！”
“一律族规伺候！！”

“听到没？？”
此话一出，龙云飞和龙云沁这对兄妹，顿时闭嘴不语。
其余龙家高层们，则是纷纷左右散开，为秦风让出了一条进入神龙石像洞口的道路。
见无人言语，龙战这才看向秦风道：“前往洞口的路已经为你打开，进去吧。”
后者闻言，点点头后，便朝着洞穴走了进去。
一步二步，步伐坚定，背影坚挺，没有半点畏惧感。
看着眼前这道逐渐消失在眼帘的背影，龙战神情复杂了些许，不知为何，他有种极强的预感，像是待会会发生了不得的大事般。
很快，秦风便进入了洞穴里。
并没有走多久，便看见了那座无比磅礴且巍峨的神龙石像。
整座石像栩栩如生，从头到尾，活灵活现，就想是一头真正的神龙化为石像般，毅力在此。
而当秦风看见这头神龙石像时，只感觉有种特别的熟悉感，好像自己体内的灵气，就来自这座神龙石像一样。
“真是壮观！！”
“想不到龙家神龙石像，比我想象中的还要威武高大。”
“要是让龙城里的那些家族势力知道龙家后山有这样一座神龙石像，不知道他们会有何感想。”
“啧啧~~”
秦风忍不住咋舌出声。
不知为何，当看见这座巍峨高大的神龙石像后，秦风居然没有半点紧张感，就好像是再见自己的老朋友一样。
content_en:
Seeing Qin Feng walking casually, Long Yunfei clenched his fists and shouted through gritted teeth: "Hey!! Qin Feng! You actually want so many people from our Long family to wait for you? You are really a big deal!!"
"Hmph, I thought you were going to be a coward, but I didn't expect that you actually dared to come."
"Aren't you afraid that your last bit of face in the Long family will turn into nothingness?"
Long Yunqin also mocked.
After hearing what the brother and sister said, Qin Feng really wanted to find an earplug to plug his ears! !
Aren't you just jealous that you are better than you and can break through to the Heavenly Realm faster than you? As for this? ?
"Junior Qin Feng, pays homage to the clan leader and all seniors."
Qin Feng bowed his hands and said.
Hearing that Qin Feng actually changed his name to his clan leader, Long Zhan frowned and seemed dissatisfied, but in the end he nodded and said, "Are you ready?"
"The leader of this clan reminds you one last time. Once you enter the cave of the Shenlong Stone Statue, you will either be swept out or light the dragon lantern. If it is the latter, our Long Family may continue to cultivate you."
"If it's the former..."
Before Long Zhan could finish his words, Qin Feng responded: "I'm ready and can go in at any time."
"I hope the patriarch will open the cave door!!"
"Hmph, what are you pretending to be? You're obviously very nervous, but you're still pretending to be calm."
"Qin Feng, I have to say that you are indeed better at pretending than this young master!!"
Long Yunfei still mocked.
When Long Zhan heard this, he rolled his eyes and said in a loud voice: "Qin Feng, the adopted son of the Long family! Today I challenge the dragon lanterns. I hope you can light three of them and get the treasure of our Long family, the divine dragon essence."
"In addition, all Long family members must be quiet during this period."
"If anyone dares to make noise!"
"Serve according to clan rules!!"
"Did you hear that??"
As soon as these words came out, the brother and sister Long Yunfei and Long Yunqin immediately shut up.
The other senior officials of the Long family dispersed left and right, making way for Qin Feng to enter the cave entrance of the Shenlong stone statue.
Seeing that no one said anything, Long Zhan looked at Qin Feng and said: "The way to the cave entrance has been opened for you, go in."
Hearing this, the latter nodded and walked into the cave.
One step at a time, the pace is firm, the back is firm, and there is no sense of fear.
Looking at the figure gradually disappearing from his eyes, Long Zhan's expression became a little complicated. For some reason, he had a strong premonition that something big was going to happen later.
Soon, Qin Feng entered the cave.
Not long after walking, I saw the extremely majestic and majestic dragon stone statue.
The entire stone statue is lifelike, from beginning to end, as if it were a real dragon transformed into a stone statue. This is where perseverance lies.
When Qin Feng saw this dragon stone statue, he felt a special sense of familiarity, as if the spiritual energy in his body came from this dragon stone statue.
“What a spectacle!!”
"I didn't expect that the dragon stone statue of the Long Family would be more powerful and taller than I imagined."
"If the family forces in Long City knew that there was such a dragon stone statue in the back of the Long family, I don't know what they would think."
"Tsk tsk~~"
Qin Feng couldn't help but screamed.
For some reason, when he saw this majestic and tall dragon stone statue, Qin Feng didn't feel any nervousness at all, as if he was seeing his old friend again.
